newsitem.title: USA: G7 agreed no new view on currencies - German source.
newsitem.headline: G7 agreed no new view on currencies - German source.

text.p: The absence of any new comment on currencies in the economic statement released by Group of Seven industrialised countries indicates that no new view was agreed, a German delegation source said.

Referring to the ninth section of the communique issued, the source said in response to a question, "There are no specific comments in there. If the view had changed I would imagine that that is where it would be."

The ninth paragraph of the statement issued read: "We reiterate our commitment to promoting international monetary stability. We have asked our finance ministers to continue to cooperate closely on economic policy and in the exchange markets."

G7 finance ministers and central bank chiefs said in April that exchange rates should reflect economic fundamentals, and that excess volatility and significant deviation from fundamental views were undesirable.
